Six years.

Six years of a horse that felt just a little stiff, a little guarded, a little short — and an owner who figured that was just her way of going.

One appointment with Dr. Leo later, she texted us that line.

Some horses carry tension so long their owners forget what relaxed even looks like. That's not a training problem. That's a body that's been uncomfortable and doing its job anyway.

If your horse in North Texas or the DFW area has always just been "a little tight" — it might be time to find out what's underneath that.

DM us to book with Dr. Leo.

Mid-June in Texas means the summer run is already well underway.

Trailers have been rolling. Horses have been competing. And most of them have never had anyone put hands on their spine to ask how they're holding up.

A maintenance check with Dr. Leo isn't about fixing a broke horse. It's about keeping a sound horse from becoming one — before the back half of summer gets here.

Dr. Leo is a cAVCA-certified equine chiropractor serving DFW and North Texas. He comes to your barn. You don't haul a sore horse anywhere.
